SysMain заранее подгружает часто использ: SysMain preloads frequently used programs into memory. “Optimizers” often disable it; on an HDD and with 8–16 GB of memory, programs and games start noticeably slower without it.
Prefetch ускоряет загрузку Windows и зап: Prefetch speeds up Windows boot and program launch. There is no need to disable it on an SSD — that is a myth from the first SSDs.
